svg.title: Let A = A⊤≥rI, r > 0, be indexed by coordinates at sites ai, and have width-η (η ≥0) absolute row and column prices at most X > 0. Principal restrictions inherit the floor by zero extension and the prices by restricting nonnegative sums. For 0 ≤θ ≤1, θX ≤r/2, take u ≥0, so Au = A + uI has an actual two-sided inverse. Fix j and conjugate Au by si = eθη dist(ai,aj). If y = A−1 u ej and wi = siyi, then (Au + E)w = ej, Eik = (Au)ik(si/sk −1).
